body:
## Summary

Historical gaps in received QUIC packet numbers could fill the 256-range ACK budget and terminate otherwise healthy concurrent connections. Retain the newest bounded ranges and a monotonic receive floor, authenticate before duplicate filtering, and ACK retained duplicates without replaying stream or control effects. Valid reordering and reliable retransmissions under fresh packet numbers remain supported.

Add focused regressions and a pinned Abyss concurrent workload gate to release validation. Include the coordinated v0.21.6 changelog covering this fix and the merged managed-H1 ALPN fix.

## Validation

- 249 QUIC tests, strict compilation, formatting, Credo, and release-tool regression tests passed.
- Independent review and 14 final regression tests after rebasing passed.
- Original OTP27 workload: published 0.21.5 failed its unchanged deadline; patched source passed two simultaneous 1 MiB echoes, the 1 MiB collector, Retry, and close isolation.
- OTP28 published baseline passed; staged source and the durable published-mode wrapper also passed. Existing pinned Abyss shutdown diagnostics remain visible.

Fixes #108
title: fix: bound QUIC receive history without terminating active connections
